title: 第11章 月黑风高夜第12章 没想到吧我打赢复活赛了
content_zh:
[完成任务【制作灵墨】，获得柳衔的奖励：【流火矢符】x1]
柳衔收起四瓶灵墨，惊奇的打量楚墨：
“短短三个月，仅凭一本中品凡功便突破至炼气三层，如此天赋，日后必成我宗栋梁。”
他自然不知楚墨根本未曾修炼《心火锻脉诀》，只当对方天资卓绝，语气中不免带上几分感慨。
“柳师谬赞。”楚墨拱手应道。
“你既已修出第一条火脉，感觉如何？”柳衔看似随意地问道。
楚墨故作沉吟，片刻后才道：“修炼速度，确实快了几分。”
《心火锻脉诀》每三层可修成一条火脉，能提升吞吐灵机的效率。若能修出三条火脉，甚至可媲美最顶级的上品凡功。
“不错，”柳衔望着恭敬垂首的楚墨，摸了摸下巴：“外门弟子考核定于六月，算来只剩三十余日，你准备得如何了？”
不待楚墨回答，他又继续道：“不必说，你修行时日尚短，底蕴浅薄，这般仓促应考，只怕凶多吉少，难逃魂归玄幡之劫。”
宗门从不关心弟子是否准备充分。只要修为达到炼气三层，就必须参与考核。
败者即是技不如人，没有培养价值，合该淘汰——反正上了魂幡，一样能为宗门效力。
但如果这小子死了，他岂不是白白损失一个人才？
想到此处，柳衔心情复杂的望着楚墨，眼中闪着捉摸不透的纠结，似乎有些难以抉择。
楚墨骤然瞳孔一缩，一股强烈的危机感涌上心头——他清楚地看到，柳衔头顶的名称竟在黄色与红色之间急速闪烁，反复横跳！
‘糟了，这老东西难道精神分裂？不会突然暴起动手吧？’他心中暗骂，只觉得此刻处境极不安全。
尽管柳衔血条仅剩10%，像个残血的6级精英怪。在游戏里属于能被低级玩家轻松“放风筝”的类型。
但今时不同往日，现实中的对手可不会像游戏ai那样呆板迟钝。
若真把柳衔当成普通野怪，怕是会被细细的剁成臊子。
楚墨思绪飞转，当即试探着出声，打断了沉思的柳衔，“柳师，若暂无其他吩咐，弟子先行告退，也好早做考核准备。”

柳衔闻言，眼神一定，名称终于稳定在黄色。他略作思索，挥挥手道，“下去吧。”
楚墨如蒙大赦，强忍着拔腿就跑的冲动，没有表现出异样，行礼告辞后，才离开对方的洞府。
洞府内，柳衔独自静立良久，方才轻声道：“楚墨......”
......
一离开柳衔洞府范围，楚墨立刻施展踏尘术，身形如风般急掠而去。
若非修士需达到炼气中期，真炁如雾才能御物飞行，他恨不得直接腾空而起。柳衔方才那突如其来的恶意，着实让他心生警惕。
炼气前、中、后期，每个境界的实力差距都十分明显。
前期真炁如丝，仅能支撑少量法术；中期真炁如雾，底蕴雄厚，可持久作战；后期真炁如潮，绵延不绝，回复速度往往快过消耗。
越阶而战，逆伐上境还是挺难做到的。
一路疾驰回住处，紧紧关上房门，楚墨仍觉不够稳妥。
可惜他这等杂役弟子，在宗内几乎毫无权利。唯有外门弟子才有资格入住设有防护阵法的洞府，而下山对杂役而言更是奢望。
‘希望柳衔那家伙不要做出什么事来才好。’
楚墨虽有些忧虑，倒还不至于惧怕——毕竟，他可是个“玩家”……
接下来的日子平静无波。楚墨每日除修炼外，便是研习法术、操练傀儡，偶尔前往北崖集会逛逛。
content_en:
[Complete the task [Making Spiritual Ink] and obtain Liu Xian’s reward: [Flowing Fire Arrow Talisman] x1]
Liu Xian put away the four bottles of spiritual ink and looked at Chu Mo in surprise:
"In just three months, I was able to break through to the third level of Qi refining with just a middle-grade ordinary skill. With such a talent, I will definitely become a pillar of our sect in the future."
Naturally, he didn't know that Chu Mo had never practiced the "Heart Fire Pulse Forging Technique" at all. He only thought that the other party was extremely talented, and there was a hint of emotion in his tone.
"Master Liu is so complimentary." Chu Mo responded with cupped hands.
"Now that you have cultivated your first fire vein, how do you feel?" Liu Xian asked seemingly casually.
Chu Mo pretended to be deep in thought, and after a moment he said: "The speed of cultivation is indeed a bit faster."
"Heart Fire Pulse Forging Technique" can cultivate a fire vein every three levels, which can improve the efficiency of breathing spiritual energy. If you can cultivate three fire veins, it can even be comparable to the top-grade mortal skills.
"That's right," Liu Xian looked at Chu Mo who bowed his head respectfully, and touched his chin: "The outer disciple examination is scheduled for June, and there are only more than thirty days left. How are you preparing?"
Without waiting for Chu Mo's answer, he continued: "Needless to say, your cultivation time is still short and your foundation is shallow. If you take the exam in such a hurry, you may be in trouble and your soul will return to Xuan Banner."
The sect never cares whether its disciples are well prepared. As long as your cultivation reaches the third level of Qi Refining, you must participate in the assessment.
The loser is one whose skills are inferior to others, has no training value, and deserves to be eliminated - anyway, if he gets the soul flag, he can still serve the sect.
But if this kid dies, wouldn't he lose a talent in vain?
Thinking of this, Liu Xian looked at Chu Mo with complicated emotions, his eyes flashed with unpredictable entanglement, and it seemed a little difficult to make a decision.
Chu Mo's pupils suddenly shrank, and a strong sense of crisis surged into his heart - he clearly saw that the name on Liu Xian's head flashed rapidly between yellow and red, jumping horizontally repeatedly!
‘Oops, is this old guy schizophrenic? You won't suddenly get violent and take action, right? ’ He cursed secretly in his heart, feeling that the situation at this moment was extremely unsafe.
Although Liu Xian's health bar only had 10% left, he looked like a level 6 elite monster with residual health. In the game, it is the type that low-level players can easily "kite".
But today is different from the past. Real opponents will not be as dull and slow as game AI.
If Liu Xian was really regarded as an ordinary wild monster, he would probably be chopped into pieces.
Chu Mo's thoughts were whirling, and he immediately spoke tentatively, interrupting Liu Xian who was deep in thought, "Master Liu, if there are no other instructions for now, I would like to leave first so that I can prepare for the assessment early."
When Liu Xian heard this, his eyes were fixed, and the name finally stabilized in yellow. He thought for a moment, waved his hand and said, "Go down."
Chu Mo was granted amnesty and resisted the urge to run away without showing any abnormality. He bowed and said goodbye before leaving the other party's cave.
In the cave, Liu Xian stood quietly alone for a long time, and then said softly: "Chu Mo..."
...
As soon as he left Liuxian Cave Mansion, Chu Mo immediately used the dust-stepping technique, and his body flew away like the wind.
If it weren't for the fact that monks need to reach the middle stage of Qi refining, and their true Qi is like mist in order to control objects and fly, he would have wished to just fly into the sky. Liu Xian's sudden malice just now really made him wary.
Before, during and after Qi refining, the strength gap in each realm is very obvious.
In the early stage, the true energy is like silk, which can only support a small number of spells; in the mid-term, the true energy is like mist, with a strong foundation and can be used for long-term combat; in the later stage, the true energy is like a tide, endless, and the recovery speed is often faster than the consumption.
It is quite difficult to fight across the ranks and go up against the enemy.
He rushed all the way back to his residence and closed the door tightly, but Chu Mo still felt that it was not safe enough.
It's a pity that handyman disciples like him have almost no rights in the sect. Only outer disciples are eligible to stay in caves equipped with protective formations, and going down the mountain is even more of a luxury for the servants.
‘I hope that guy Liu Xian doesn’t do anything. ’
Although Chu Mo was a little worried, he was not afraid - after all, he was a "player"...
pick upThe rest of the day was uneventful. In addition to practicing every day, Chu Mo studies spells, practices puppets, and occasionally goes to the Beiya gathering.
